## Arrival-order partitions of the named fixtures

- chain3 (A–B first by score; B–C would join A and C): expected [['A', 'B'], ['C']]; arrival order produced [[['A'], ['B', 'C']], [['A', 'B'], ['C']]]
- tie_by_pair_key (equal scores: pair key (A,B) < (B,C); pairs given reversed): expected [['A', 'B'], ['C']]; arrival order produced [[['A'], ['B', 'C']], [['A', 'B'], ['C']]]
- judgment_first (the merge judgment C–D ranks above the 0.95 pair; B–C then joins B and D): expected [['B'], ['C', 'D']]; arrival order produced [[['B'], ['C', 'D']], [['B', 'C'], ['D']]]
- refusal_cascade (B–C refused; C–D accepted; A–D refused because {A,B} and {C,D} hold A–C): expected [['A', 'B'], ['C', 'D']]; arrival order produced [[['A'], ['B', 'C', 'D']], [['A', 'B'], ['C', 'D']], [['A', 'B', 'D'], ['C']], [['A', 'D'], ['B', 'C']]]
- two_cannots (B–C refused by A–C, A–D refused by B–D; in arrival order B–C first gives {A,D},{B,C}): expected [['A', 'B'], ['C', 'D']]; arrival order produced [[['A', 'B'], ['C', 'D']], [['A', 'D'], ['B', 'C']]]
- duplicate_pair (A–B scored and judged counts once, as a judgment, so it precedes B–C at 0.99): expected [['A', 'B'], ['C']]; arrival order produced [[['A'], ['B', 'C']], [['A', 'B'], ['C']]]
- isolated_and_long_chain (ties broken by pair key along the chain: E4–E5 is last and joins E1 and E5; X is cannot-linked only): expected [['E1', 'E2', 'E3', 'E4'], ['E5'], ['X']]; arrival order produced [[['E1'], ['E2', 'E3', 'E4', 'E5'], ['X']], [['E1', 'E2'], ['E3', 'E4', 'E5'], ['X']], [['E1', 'E2', 'E3'], ['E4', 'E5'], ['X']], [['E1', 'E2', 'E3', 'E4'], ['E5'], ['X']]]
